summary: WHISPERS: Realms of the Nine is a fantasy MMO prototype whose MMORPG Tools menu and character-creation flow lead into the Lantern March. Place configs and scenes define the hub and resource regions, procedural scripts supply geometry, and the MMORPG Tools mod owns character lifecycle, movement-facing RPG state, camera modes and UI.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - default title/travel menu scene, with authored town art and shared terrain decoration.
places/character-creation-land/ - character preview scene with terrain off and a preview camera/lighting setup.
places/main/ - six-cell Lantern March world: Lantern's Reach hub at origin, Briarwild west, Emberstone Quarry east and the distant north spire landmark.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach buildings and props; briar-bridge sits at x -50.5, z -9 with deck origin y 4.4, using scripts/gen/stone-bridge.js.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene and places/main/cells/x1z0.scene - west tagged timber trees and east tagged copper nodes, respectively.
places/main/config.yaml - main terrain, cinematic atmosphere, scatter and bridge approaches flattened to y 4.4 near x -64 and -37.
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry/defaultPlace main-menu-land; binds shared player, camera, arrival, MMORPG UI and nametag behavior.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - MMORPG Tools template/behavior registration for menu, player and gameplay/creation camera behaviors.
templates/player.js#player - native player template; runs humanoid locomotion then core movement behavior.
templates/camera.js#camera - native custom camera template; core scripts/camera.js consumes engine look orientation.
places/main-menu-land/config.yaml and places/character-creation-land/config.yaml - separate menu/preview place roots and atmosphere settings.
places/main/config.yaml - playable-world spawn, gravity, terrain generation/materials, vegetation scatter and cinematic look.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ - integrated RPG package: lifecycle, character selection, gameplay/orbit camera, interaction, quests and UI.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - shared RPG data and panel renderers used by mod behaviors and ui.js; races now define Marchborn/Briarkin and Vanguard.
scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js and stone-bridge.js - procedural geometry used by authored scene instances with parameters.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, pebble.js and grass-look.js - terrain decoration geometries/material reused by place scatter bindings.
scripts/lib/data/{player,camera,world}.yml - shared movement, camera-height and terrain-height values read by core scripts.
mods/aaa-quality-kit/look-cinema.js and scripts/look-default.js - alternative post-process looks selected by place atmosphere; main uses cinema.
mods/codex/ - creator-facing document panel and document operations; doc-<tab>.js pages are assembled by codex-doc.js, not runtime game state.
mods/wow-camera-controls/ - separately packaged reusable camera controls alongside the MMORPG mod's camera behaviors.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onInput, update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit, onInput, update.
scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, update; scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/gen/stone-bridge.js - geometry, collider; scripts/gen/shape.js supplies box/quad helpers.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - movement/state, avatar and roster/music helpers, saveCharacter, onSpawn and lifecycle handlers.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/character-select.js - preview/model helpers, onSpawn, update, onInput; main-menu-mgr.js owns roster/menu handlers.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js - default renderer, main-menu settings, HUD layout, zone banner, WASD and character-creation renderers; lib/ui-hud.js exports renderTargetDisplay, renderHUD.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/quest-giver.js - onSpawn, update, onInteract; mods/codex/lib/codex-ops.js - document operations/serializers.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent keyed by body and writes core character velocity; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state and character yaw, animation channels and seated locomotion.
scripts/camera.js - core camera rig eye pose and local-player hiding; engine view provides orientation.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js and character-select.js - MMORPG player/character creation state, roster transitions, persistence and preview lifecycle.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - orbit input/pose and creation-phase framing for the mod camera path.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/quest-giver.js - NPC proximity and quest-dialog handoff; quest definitions live in lib/quest-data.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js and lib/ui-*.js - render presentation from player/world state; UI is not gameplay-state owner.
scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js plus scripts/lib/data/world.yml - core terrain height/material inputs; sim.js currently owns no state.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → MMORPG menu/player/character-select/main-menu-mgr behaviors → character creation and transition into main.

Character creation confirm in character-select.js → name registry check and character state/persistence; registry failure creates an active character id and continues loading rather than leaving the form blocked.
Creation camera behavior path in mod.json → character-select.js installs mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera-creation.js → frames the preview; gameplay camera handles orbit outside creation.
world.config.yaml player template → scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js then scripts/player.js; gait samples movement before this tick's movement velocity write.
moveX/moveZ/jump input → scripts/player.js onInput stores room-local intent → update eases velocity and applies place gravity.
world.config.yaml UI renderer → mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js reads local player/world state → lib/ui-* renderers compose HUD, menu, quest and panels; nametag renders separately.
Character creation state → ui.js renderCharacterCreation and injected name input → setCharName/confirmCharacter actions; NAME_SWEEP removes the persistent DOM name box outside creation.
quest-giver.js proximity/interact → lib/quest-data.js and player activeQuests → showQuestDialog/questDialogData on player → ui.js/lib/ui-quest.js.
places/main/config.yaml terrain generator → scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js reads world.yml; scatter bindings use grass/flower/pebble geometry and grass-look material.
places/main/cells/*.scene scripted objects → scripts/gen geometry; briar-bridge specifically uses stone-bridge.js with geometry and collider exports.
stone bridge deck spans X with L=22, W=4.2 and rise=1.4; scene origin is y=4.4 and terrain flatten patches approach ends to the same height.
world.config.yaml lighting/arrival bindings → scripts/lighting.js and scripts/arrival.js; arrival hooks remain empty; sim.js ticks once per second without state work.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js and stone-bridge.js - procedural scene geometry reused by instances, varied by kind/shape parameters, dimensions, seed and transforms.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by density, scale and seed; grass-look supplies material separately.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle behaviors registered by mod.json.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - paired gameplay orbit and preview camera modes with creation-phase guards.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-*.js - modular panel renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu, quest, inventory, map, character and settings.
scripts/look-default.js and mods/aaa-quality-kit/look-cinema.js - alternative whole-frame post-process looks selected per place.
migrationNotes: Keep core movement intent and locomotion scratch in room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity and place config owns gravity.
templates/player.js runs humanoid-locomotion before player.js; behavior order determines whether gait samples prior-tick or current movement velocity.
Core scripts/camera.js uses engine look orientation and feetPosition + eyeHeight × effectiveScale.y; MMORPG orbit/creation cameras are a distinct path.
MMORPG camera.js delegates creation framing to camera-creation.js and guards orbit during creation/dialog states; preserve these phase and panel guards.
Bridge scene origin is deck-end height y=4.4, while its mesh deck rises 1.4 toward midspan; terrain approach flatten centers at x=-64 and -37 also use y=4.4.

Character creation uses race indices 0/1 for Marchborn/Briarkin and Vanguard; starting stats, class items and HUD stat keys are cross-coupled across lib/stat-calc.js, class-items.js and player/UI state.
